title: fix(deps): force shell-quote >=1.8.4 to resolve critical CVE-2026-9277
body:
## Summary

Resolves [Dependabot alert #128](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/security/dependabot/128) — **critical** shell command injection in `shell-quote` (CVE-2026-9277 / GHSA-w7jw-789q-3m8p): `quote()` does not escape line terminators in object-token `.op` values, so a literal `\n` passes through and the shell executes what follows as a second command. Patched in `shell-quote@1.8.4`.

## Analysis

- **Transitive dev dependency only**: root `devDependencies` → `concurrently@9.2.1` → `shell-quote@1.8.3`. No workspace package depends on it directly, and nothing in the repo invokes `concurrently` at runtime — exposure is limited to the dev toolchain.
- `concurrently@9.2.1` (latest 9.x) pins `shell-quote` to exactly `1.8.3`, so no in-range update can pick up the patch.
- `concurrently@10.x` does ship `shell-quote@1.8.4`, but requires Node >= 22 while this repo's engines declare Node >= 20 — upgrading it would silently raise the contributor/CI floor.

## Fix

Add a pnpm override (alongside the existing `qs`/`tmp`/`uuid` security overrides in `package.json`):

```json
"shell-quote@<1.8.4": "^1.8.4"
```

Lockfile re-resolves `shell-quote` 1.8.3 → 1.8.4; no other resolution changes (10-line lockfile diff).

## Verification

- `pnpm why -r shell-quote` → single version `1.8.4`, via `concurrently@9.2.1`
- Full test suite (`pnpm test`): **214 files / 3521 tests passed**, 1 file + 24 tests skipped, 0 failures
